I replied to Dana in #north-team: the latest figure for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 261 seats, which Ilse posted there on Oct 14. Nothing posted since then changes it. But I couldn't find anything confirming it's signed or final, so I suggested she check with Ilse or June if the tracker needs the contracted number.

I only read #north-team, which Dana can see too. I didn't look through the account files. Seat counts count as account details rather than finance figures, so no approval was needed.
